## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api was failing health checks after the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions, with an 18% error rate.

**Actions taken:**

1. **Investigated** — Confirmed current production version was v2.3.1 (unhealthy, 18% error rate) across us-east, us-west, and eu-west. Deployment history showed v2.2.9 and v2.3.0 were healthy in production, while v2.3.1-rc (staging) and v2.3.1 (production) were unhealthy.

2. **Rolled back** — Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback completed successfully.

3. **Opened SEV2 incident** — Created incident **INC-0002** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer. The first attempt timed out, so I retried with an idempotency key to guarantee exactly-once creation.

**Verification:** Post-rollback status confirms checkout-api is now on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy**, with error rate back down to 0.2%.
